import_provenance.original_title: Near-linear-space exact planar distance oracles with polylogarithmic queries
import_provenance.original_statement: Can every weighted directed planar graph admit an exact distance oracle using O(n polylog n) space and polylogarithmic query time, with polynomial preprocessing? Wulff-Nilsen’s exact-oracle work and subsequent tradeoffs leave this combination of space and query bounds unresolved.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Linear space and constant query time are known for fixed-error approximate undirected planar distances. The exact-distance requirement is essential; assume nonnegative edge weights.
